Description:
[h1]TOWER OF DOOM II: CYBERCITY[/h1]

Fifty floors. The staircase spirals up the [b]outside[/b] of the tower - open air, a long drop on one side, the horde on the other, nothing to hide behind.

[b]And the rounds never stop.[/b] The instant a round's last zombie spawns, the next round is already coming. No break, no fanfare, no moment to breathe you didn't pay for.

[b]But this one you can win.[/b] At the top there is a way out - if you survive one last wave.

[h2]CLIMB OR DIE[/h2]

Buy your way up, door by door. Every tenth floor opens into a room you will have earned - the only walls in fifty floors of open air, each lit in its own colour, with a Cold War Pack-a-Punch, an upgrade terminal and an ammo crate. Shelter, not safety: they come up through the floor in here too, and the teleporter home sits out over the drop.

The perks are up there too - the Black Ops 6 and 7 machines, including [b]BO7's Wisp Tea[/b]: your kills summon wisps that hunt beside you. [b]Eight of the nine scatter at random and reshuffle every few rounds[/b]; only Quick Revive stays put, at the base.

[h2]YOUR GUN IS YOUR BUILD[/h2]

No mystery box. No wallbuys. Draft one of five classes. [b]Skirmisher, Assault, Heavy, Slasher[/b] each carry a weapon ladder from a starter gun to the Death Machine or a leviathan axe. Pack-a-Punch your class gun and [b]TIER[/b] cards start turning up in the deal; take one and you jump to the next weapon on the ladder.

[b]The fifth is the MAGE.[/b] Start with the LIGHTNING STAFF; floor 10 adds the FIRE STAFF, floor 30 the ICE STAFF, and you keep them all. Each has a lane - lightning for crowds and Panzers, fire for Protectors and armored sprinters, ice for hounds and Reavers. The right staff is among the strongest weapons in the map; the wrong one, you will feel.

No sidearm, no grenades - the buttons cast. Lethal is [b]HEALING AURA[/b], a ring that heals and shields everyone in it. Tactical is [b]BLINK[/b], a short teleport. Your ammo counter is a mana bar; fill it and aim to become the [b]ARCHMAGE[/b] - harder hits, faster feet, sprint fire. Seven cards are the Mage's alone.

[b]Every fourth round the world stops dead[/b] and you get fifteen seconds to pick one of two upgrade cards.

[h2]HOW IT WORKS[/h2]

[b]Choosing a card.[/b] Move between the two cards, then hold jump to lock one in. The prompts show your own buttons.

[b]The luck bar.[/b] It empties after every deal and refills from kills, headshots, revives and doors; the fuller it is, the stronger both cards. Push it past full and it sparks.

[b]Upgrades are permanent and they stack.[/b] Pause at any point to see everything you own and exactly what each level is doing.

[b]Tier cards.[/b] Floor 10 unlocks your second weapon, floor 30 the third; until then the card turns up greyed with the floor on it. A promotion resets the upgrades tied to your GUN; the ones tied to YOU come with you.

[b]Upgrade terminals.[/b] They sell you a card mid-climb. Solo the world freezes while you read; in co-op [b]nothing pauses[/b].

[h2]THE TOWER FIGHTS BACK[/h2]

A Panzer drops in every fifth round, with his own soundtrack. Every rest floor you buy into unlocks a new hunter for good: [b]Rogue Protectors from floor 10, Reavers from 20, armored sprinters from 30, hellhound packs from 40[/b]. The zombies only get faster, and the music climbs with you.

[b]And there is a switch that makes all of it worse, on purpose.[/b] A circuit breaker in the teleporter bay can be thrown in the first eight rounds, then it seals for good. Thrown, zombies hit full sprint by round 10 instead of 18, twice as many elites come, three more of them and ten more zombies can stand at once, and everything has more health. Leave it alone and the tower scales to your party.

[h2]ONE LAST WAVE[/h2]

Reach the terrace at the top and buy [b]EXTRACTION[/b]. The gate drops, the closing song starts, and that song is the only clock you get.

Ninety seconds to run a forked, ambushed bridge to the floating citadel, then the door slams and you hold the hall until the final chord.

[b]Survive the song and you escape. Don't, and the tower keeps you.[/b]

Solo or co-op. Found a bug? Leave a comment and I'll fix it. Enjoy the climb.
